name: Kousaka Mayuri
source:
Although she doesn’t show it, she is a hard worker who can achieve surprising things when she puts her mind to it.
It was her own wish to enter the academy, but this wish stemmed from certain woes.
She is quite social but takes care even with her Amitie partners so as not to let her troubles be known.
Her interests are making sweets and art appreciation
She is one of [url=/c16861]Suou’s[/url] Amitie partners.

[From [url=http://flowersgame.com/]Jast USA[/url]]
